d:
A legendary comedy film inspires an unusual custom motorcycle project at Orange County Choppers. With Bill Murray's Caddyshack as the creative starting point, Paul Jr., Rick Petko and Vinnie DiMartino work on golf-inspired bodywork and custom hardware. But with playful ideas flying around the shop, Paul Sr. is determined to keep the team on schedule.
Watch American Chopper Season 3 Episode 72 only on discovery+ India.
